184. Beyond Fate (5)
Unknown.
Valeria opened the record window, but no information from inside the castle was revealed.

If it was a typical war, they would have already received intelligence from scouts like the Moomyeong, or they would have estimated the approximate size of the forces from the air using the fleet and dragons.
However, this war made all such actions meaningless. Regardless of what danger lurked beyond the darkness, they had no choice but to push through.
The fleet began shelling the walls of the castle that were stretched out on either side of the opening gate.
Knowing that physical impact was effective on the walls, the fleet had to destroy them to secure a passage to enter the castle.
Because flying over them was impossible.
However, Jin felt increasingly uneasy with each step he took towards the castle gate.
'The castle gate... is still opening.'
As if it was welcoming him.
As he got closer, the darkness contained within the gate grew larger, as if it was allowing not an enemy, but an ally to enter.
"Lord Jin."
Lonil spoke. He, along with Octavia and a part of the specter army, had descended to the ground.
"Speak."
"Shouldn't we destroy the wall to some extent and then enter? The castle gate is being opened provocatively."
Just as Jin was about to reply, an anxious and heavy noise echoed in the ears of everyone on the battlefield.
That-that-that……
A low and gloomy noise, like the groan of a monster in a cave.
Jin and the people could only look up at the sky involuntarily.
'Is it Ram's main cannon? Did Lady Rin fail?'
It was moving. The monstrous barrel already had a huge piece of chaos energy attached to it.

The fleet immediately converted the magic power they were using for bombardment to deploy shields. Signal flares alerting to the sudden situation erupted here and there, forming a blue protective shield.
Those on the ground also set up defensive positions centered around Jin, and Ram's main cannon spit out the massive chaos energy it was holding.
Paaa…!
Ram's bombardment was thrust straight down between Jin and the fleet.
Five ships that were there disappeared without a trace, and the black pillar that annihilated them was not disappearing.
"The 4th flagship Fist has been annihilated!"
"We need to confirm the change of the 4th fleet's flagship, we have lost more than 10 ships...!"
"Enemy's main cannon reloading, the expected strike point is Kinzel 1st Fleet!"
"Our scattering speed can't keep up with Ram's reloading speed!"
The fleet's wizards were screaming like mad.
The fleet's protective shield was nothing more than a scrap of paper in front of Ram's main cannon.
The horrifying bombardment they experienced during the first general offensive was starting again. The wizards, reminded of that day's nightmare, were becoming immersed in terror.
Ram fired its second cannon.
Although Grunil was also the flagship of Kinzel, it could never handle Ram's main cannon with the ship's own abilities alone.
[Tsk!]
Fortunately, Zephyrine, hovering above Grunil, expelled a breath just before the
bombardment hit.
Unlike during the first general offensive, Zephyrine's body wasn't pierced even after directly being hit by the main cannon.
While it was partly due to Zephyrine becoming stronger, it was also because Ram's main cannon was weaker than the first shot.
However, the fact that the main cannon was weaker didn't mean that the total power had decreased.
"The main cannon has switched to a radial form! The damage range includes the entire fleet...!"
The black meteor shower spreading like a spider web was striking the entire aerial force. With each second passing, ships were breaking apart and dragons were screaming in agony.
Veil flew into the sky, spreading a golden power, and Orgal deployed a protective shield covering the entire aerial force.
When Orgal's protective shield was fully formed, the damage was drastically reduced, but it seemed like Ram wouldn't allow it. The reloading speed was getting faster and faster.
From the beginning, the altitude of the entire aerial force had been lowered, so the situation was inherently disadvantageous, and there was no time for such efforts.
At this rate, the aerial force would soon be annihilated or suffer damage close to obliteration.
Swift judgment was needed. Veradin gritted his teeth and alternately glanced at Ram's cannon protruding beneath the clouds and the battlefield.

'Retreat is also difficult... The anti-field that Jin broke through earlier has been reformed. If we rush to break through the anti-field and attempt to retreat, there's a high chance of annihilation.'
Veradin's gaze landed on the castle gate. On the gate, which was still opening wide with darkness.
The gate had acquired a width sufficient for the fleet to enter.
And the castle walls, although slightly losing their perfectly right-angled shape due to the shock spread by Ram's main cannon, were holding firm, incomparably stronger than the fleet.
"Advance the fleet. The entire fleet enters the castle. Let the ground forces know as well!"
At Veradin's command, the commanders hesitated for a moment, but immediately prepared for acceleration.
Jin and the ground heroes, reading the fleet's signal, were intercepting Ram's main cannon that was continuously being fired.
The first to touch the darkness of the castle gate was Kozjak, who had been leading. The sight of the ships moving into the darkness continued.
Indeed, Veradin's judgment was effective. The castle of the monster had turned into an
umbrella, protecting the ships that entered.
By the time all the fleet, dragons, and ground forces had completed their entry into the castle,
The remaining fleet and dragons accounted for about 70%.
The whole aerial force had lost 30% of its strength in less than 10 minutes.
The allies stared out of the castle gate with dazed eyes.
Only the same darkness as when they entered was spread out there.
Because of this, people felt like they had just crossed some boundary. They felt as if they had crossed the boundary from Inse into the world of the monsters.
However, the ruthless noise and vibrations of Lam's cannon flipping the ground were still being transmitted inside.
In other words, the temporary alliance had escaped from that bombardment into the castle of the monsters.
They couldn't help but feel a great humiliation at this fact, as much as begging for mercy from the enemy.
Inside the castle, unlike when observed beyond the castle gate, it was possible to visually confirm the structure.
The immense cavity that lets you feel the scale of the castle as it is.
Even though the entire remaining fleet had entered, there was no sense of claustrophobia from the ceiling.
It didn't seem strange to say it wasn't inside the castle but in the middle of a plain at night.
"...It seems much bigger than when seen from the outside."
"What's the reason for creating such a vast space?"
"We were hit by a sucker punch from the start. If you stay outside, you die from the bombardment, and if you try to avoid it, you have to enter the enemy's castle."
The allies each spoke a word and looked around when suddenly, the noise and vibration of Lam's cannon from the outside ceased.
The castle gate had closed.
"Kuuak!"
"Kheuuk!"
And as soon as the gate closed, the knights and wizards with the lowest rank in the allied forces began to scream.
A mental attack.
The mental attack of the monsters that oppressed all of Inse before the expedition had penetrated into the allies' inner selves.
Inside the ships, those who could not withstand the shock began to faint, and even the dragons showed signs of twisting their bodies and falling to the ground.
The absurdity of dealing with a god was thus continuing.
Fortunately, at least those with a certain level of willpower did not have any problems.
This was evidence that Rosa had been hit in the previous battle of conscience that Jin had fought.
Rosa had indiscriminately spread mental attacks regardless of the high and low of willpower and rank at that time.
[If we had come here without winning the preliminary battle in the last internal war with Rickarton, we would already have been annihilated.]
Orgal said, looking at Jin. In his eyes, there was a faint light wrapping Jin's body in this darkness.
It was a light that beings of a lower rank could not confirm.

[Although it's close to a kidnapping, there was an invitation and a welcoming ceremony, so we have to respond. Quickly rescue the fainted personnel and move forward. As everyone can feel, there is no chance of winning this battle if it is prolonged.]
That statement was accurate.
Just standing still was wasteful as those who were being mentally attacked were emerging.
But where should we go?
It was not easy to figure out. The interior was so vast it felt empty, and it was open in all directions, like a plain.
This meant that an attack could come from any side.
In the worst case, enemies could swarm in from all sides at once.
Everyone's gaze landed on Jin. Just as naturally as one would look towards a light when trapped in darkness.
Jin was reading the aura with his eyes closed. The whole area was filled with a dreadful aura, but a particularly intense energy was rising from the center.
As soon as Jin started walking, the allies followed him.
Every hundred steps or so, more people fell into a stupor due to the mental attack. Just pressing on while enduring this meant each person was engaged in their own struggle.
They moved on for about thirty minutes. Until then, the army of chaos had not attacked the allies.
Instead, Jin and the allies were standing still, looking down at the cliff that had suddenly appeared in front of them.
Just like when they first attacked the castle walls, they could not cross it by flying.
Veil and Zephyrin attempted to fly, but as soon as they tried to cross over the cliff, their altitude dropped as if something was dragging them down.
The two almost fell down the cliff without warning.
Nothing existed beyond the cliff.
A new path could only be formed by going down the cliff.
The interior of the monster's castle was a structure that led only underground.
Jin looked down the cliff.
'Is it trying to drag us deeper and deeper....'
It was like a swamp.
Just as Jin thought, Rosa was dragging the allies to the lowest point in the world. As if they could only confront him face-to-face once they reached there.
"I'll go down first to check."
Jin said, drawing his sword.
"I'm not sure if I can send a signal up from below, but if there's no news 10 minutes after I go down, the remaining top forces should enter in order."
Normally, and if it was not Jin.
The allies would have suggested more caution, saying it was dangerous.
However, in this war, Jin's judgment was absolute, and a path that he could not open was a path that no one could open.
As Jin began descending the cliff, his comrades stared at his back.
For some reason, they couldn't imagine Jin falling into a trap. Regardless of what was waiting for him down there.
